content.short: Metric is an onchain exchange operating on Hyperliquid and Monad.
content.description: Metric is a decentralized exchange deployed across Hyperliquid, Monad, Binance Chain, Ethereum, Polygon, Base and Avalanche. Its V2 release runs the same pool contracts on each network, so a trader sees consistent behaviour wherever they connect. Liquidity providers supply those pools and collect the trading fees they generate.
content.meta: Exchange markets on Hyperliquid and Monad, two chains built for throughput by different routes.
